Welcome.

But Nina's mom worked late.

A big banner over the windows read, "After School Fun and Games at Kid Central." Nina didn't see anyone she knew.
She felt nervous.
Oh, there's my name.
Nina spotted a name tag with her name on it and sat down.
Izzy was excited to be at Kid Central.
But her name tag was wrong.
Isabelle.
Izzy read, "I'm Izzy, not Isabelle." Izzy looked at the boy next to her.
You must be Jason.
Welcome everyone, please find your seat.
Miss Shelley called.

Jason, what do you like?

Jason.

Cheeseburgers.
